definition: Content hash of the artifact this record attests.
shot_grammar_note: The name the M-layer edges are drawn from — inputs are named by hash, never by filename.

definition: The generative engine that produced the artifact.
shot_grammar_note: Two units naming different engines cannot be joined by a P-Node. That is what makes GRAFT force an intra unit.

definition: The parameters the engine ran under.
shot_grammar_note: Folded with engine and inputs into the canonical determinism key the cache is addressed by.

definition: The hashes of every input consumed.
shot_grammar_note: These are the M-layer's edges. An edge exists only where a record names an input — never inferred from a name or a folder.

definition: The moment the artifact was made.
Per-machine P-256 attestation that the runtime witnessed the computation.
shot_grammar_note: Proves a machine, not a person. Carried in the boundary list so no reader has to discover it.

definition: The canonical determinism key over engine, inputs and parameters, carried on the coding unit.
shot_grammar_note: The decoder re-uses a previously computed frame only when the exact computation recurs, and re-derives otherwise. A hit is graded reused, not proved reproduced.

definition: Per-pin distances measured when the encoder synthesised a shadow intra frame to test a predicted chain.
shot_grammar_note: PROPOSED. The codec computes drift as one scalar against a threshold tau. Decomposed into named pins it becomes a diagnosis — subject-identity drifted, everything else held — which tells the encoder to force an intra unit and tells the director why.
